name: content-factory
description: Self-hosted review-first batch pipeline for vertical video drafts.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @content-factory/shared && npm run build -w @content-factory/database && npm run build -w @content-factory/api && npm run build -w @content-factory/worker && npm run build -w @content-factory/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @content-factory/shared && npm run build -w @content-factory/database && npm run typecheck -w @content-factory/api && npm run typecheck -w @content-factory/worker && npm run typecheck -w @content-factory/web
